# Great Falls Tool Bus

> The Great Falls Tool Bus is a member-tree application for Lewiston-Auburn,
> Maine (`app-stateful-spoke`, tinyland.repo.json). This repository's public
> agent index is /llms.txt and /agent-map.md; there is no live /agent route
> (single-product history, L72 Q3-A, 2026-08-21 -- the public information
> site is the separate gftb-site repository).

## Skills

This repository carries six tinyland-* skills under `.agents/skills/`:

- [tinyland-whoami](https://github.com/Great-Falls-Tool-Bus/greatfallstoolbus.org/blob/main/.agents/skills/tinyland-whoami/SKILL.md): cold-landing repo-role classification.
- [tinyland-spawn-sister-site](https://github.com/Great-Falls-Tool-Bus/greatfallstoolbus.org/blob/main/.agents/skills/tinyland-spawn-sister-site/SKILL.md): user-only spawn ritual for sister sites.
- [tinyland-scaffold-doctor](https://github.com/Great-Falls-Tool-Bus/greatfallstoolbus.org/blob/main/.agents/skills/tinyland-scaffold-doctor/SKILL.md): house-style drift audit.
- [tinyland-repo-contract](https://github.com/Great-Falls-Tool-Bus/greatfallstoolbus.org/blob/main/.agents/skills/tinyland-repo-contract/SKILL.md): Just, Nix, gitleaks, validation, and no-ad-hoc-file contract.
- [tinyland-static-spoke](https://github.com/Great-Falls-Tool-Bus/greatfallstoolbus.org/blob/main/.agents/skills/tinyland-static-spoke/SKILL.md): static spoke site customization and projection rules.
- [tinyland-flywheel-bazel](https://github.com/Great-Falls-Tool-Bus/greatfallstoolbus.org/blob/main/.agents/skills/tinyland-flywheel-bazel/SKILL.md): cache-first Bazel and GloriousFlywheel RBE wiring.

## Mail lace-up skills

The seven skills in the block below are generated by
scripts/build-agent-skills.mjs (`just skills-build`); do not hand-edit them.

<!-- BEGIN generated: mail-laceup skills (just skills-build) -->
Point any agent at these to lace up a mail client for the keyholders list
(keyholders@latoolb.us). One skill per client, derived from
src/lib/data/mail-clients.ts.

## Agent Routes

## Operating Constraints

- Use `just <recipe>` for every repo operation.
- Use `nix develop --command just <recipe>` in CI.
- Keep Flywheel endpoints and credentials in environment-owned authority, never source.
- Run gitleaks through Justfile recipes.
- Keep static spokes static. Do not add runtime auth, database, payment, or broker-fetch behavior.
